name: Compositional Relaxed Concurrency
description: A compositional relaxed-concurrency semantics for a fragment of the C11 model — non-atomic accesses with catch-fire semantics, release-acquire accesses, and sequentially-consistent fences. Because the relaxed fragment is excluded, the model sidesteps the thin-air problem. The authors built a tool for automatic verification of program transformations in this fragment.

catSupport.note: The underlying consistency model is a C11 fragment (release-acquire, SC fences, catch-fire non-atomics) that cat expresses; the compositional denotational layer is a reasoning device on top of it, not extra behaviour.
